from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for color in (1,6):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for R,C in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=R-r,C-c
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr!=0:
                    sr=1 if dr>0 else -1; sc=1 if dc>0 else -1
                    for k in range(abs(dr)+1):
                        rr,cc=r+sr*k,c+sc*k
                        if g[rr][cc] in (4,color): g[rr][cc]=color
    return g
'''
